experiment: Xyce on constructs of the T2 decks (e2e 11 and 15, phase 2): a .STEP and a .DC of the .param that a linear E source's gain {g} reads, the list starting at the nominal (0.5), with the nominal at 0.3, and with a VALUE= E source; a single-terminal Verilog-A source, E66's nan.va (which reads $abstime) and a plain V(a) <+ 1.0; a diode line with a positional area and a parameter after it; a level-3 MOSFET card with WD
result: a .STEP or .DC of a .param that a linear E source's gain reads gives gain 0 at the point whose value equals the .param's nominal (.param g=0.5, .STEP g LIST 0.5 0.75 2: V(OUT) = 0 where -1 is right; -1.5 and -4 after it); a nominal of 0.3, or a VALUE= E source, are right; E66's nan.va leaves its node at 0 V under PyMS, rc 0 (its $abstime does not build, E125), while a single-terminal V(a) <+ 1.0 drives its node to 1.001 V into 1 kohm; a diode line with a positional area followed by any parameter is "Unrecognized fields for device D1", rc 1 (`D1 a 0 dm 4e-07` and `D1 a 0 dm area=4e-07 m=1` run); MOSFET3 has no WD ("No model parameter WD found for model NM of type NMOS, parameter ignored.", rc 0, which the parameter scan makes status 2)
rules: R-tests-1 / §4.5: on Xyce a swept .param must not reach a linear E (vcvs) gain directly (the VALUE= form is right); this row tells when the workaround can go
§4.5: xyce.render prints a diode's area by name (area=), never positionally before other parameters
§7.2 [E43]: xyce.output_problems makes "No model parameter ... found" status 2, naming the parameter
